title: Broken on purpose
summary: A design with mistakes in it. Find them with the flow check icon.

lesson.problem: This board looks plausible, but it has wrong connections and loose parts. Can you get it to work?
why: Click the status icon at the top right of the board to see what is wrong and why. Fix a problem, check again, and repeat until it says it works.
Then keep experimenting: add components, rewire things, switch on Worst day, and see what the checker says. Only well-known mistakes get a warning, so unusual structures are yours to try.
takeaways: Clients should reach data through a server, never directly.
A component nothing sends traffic to does nothing.
Watch the icon: small changes are easier to explain than big ones.
